MiniNVR Label Sans SC Regular - label-only subset

Original typeface: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular, version 2.004.
Upstream: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
Tag: Sans2.004
Commit: 523d033d6cb47f4a80c58a35753646f5c3608a78

Original copyright notice, preserved from the font name table:
© 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).

This Modified Version remains licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
See the accompanying OFL.txt. Distribute this notice and OFL.txt with the font.

Changes: retained printable ASCII U+0020-U+007E and only the characters needed
for the 13 labels listed below plus the optional phrase 识别目标. Removed other
glyphs, hinting, layout feature rules and the unused BASE table; desubroutinized
CFF outlines. Glyph designs were not redrawn. Renamed the primary family,
full name, unique ID, PostScript and CFF font names to MiniNVR Label Sans SC
to identify this derivative independently. Original copyright and license
metadata are retained. The upstream authors do not endorse this derivative.

Labels: 行人, 汽车, 座椅, 餐桌, 猫, 狗, 手机, 沙发, 床, 电视, 笔记本电脑, 杯子, 瓶子

FontTools 4.67.0 was used only at build time. Runtime use needs
only the application's existing Pillow/FreeType support. No system font
installation, network access, or FontTools runtime dependency is required.

To rebuild, run ../build_subset.py after ../download_sources.py. Both scripts
operate within this ignored preparation directory. The downloaded upstream
source and temporary build tool are not intended for product packaging.
